tool_schemas.name: exampleTool
tool_schemas.description: Returns a minimal example response for verifying that Gemini Server is reachable and the MCP toolchain is wired correctly. This endpoint does not page and returns a single payload only. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any unexpected parameters are provided (this tool accepts none).

tool_schemas.name: gemini_generateContent
tool_schemas.description: Generates a single, non-streaming completion using the specified Gemini model and returns the full model response once the request finishes (use either `contents` or `prompt`, with `contents` taking precedence when provided). This endpoint does not page; it records the request for auditability and mirrors any returned remote metadata in the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid required fields (including malformed `api_key_id`) or unsupported extra properties, UNAUTHORIZED if `api_key_id` is not accessible/allowed, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the underlying Gemini API rejects the request (e.g., invalid model/config or safety refusal).

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for this generation request.

model.description: Gemini model name to use for generation (e.g., "gemini-1.5-pro").

prompt.description: Plain text prompt to generate from.

contents.description: Full Gemini contents payload for multimodal/structured prompts; if provided, it is used instead of prompt.

generation_config.description: Gemini generationConfig parameters (e.g., temperature, topP, maxOutputTokens).

safety_settings.description: Gemini safety settings array to apply to the request.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_generateContentStream
tool_schemas.description: Generates a completion using the specified Gemini model and returns the response incrementally as streamed chunks, using `contents` instead of `prompt` when `contents` is provided. This endpoint does not page; it tracks the streaming request and returns the stream events/chunks in order until completion or failure. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid required fields (including malformed `api_key_id`) or unsupported extra properties, UNAUTHORIZED if `api_key_id` is not accessible/allowed, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the Gemini streaming call fails or is rejected (including invalid model/config or safety refusal).

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for this streaming generation request.

model.description: Gemini model name to use for generation (e.g., "gemini-1.5-pro").

prompt.description: Plain text prompt to generate from; streamed response will be returned in chunks.

contents.description: Full Gemini contents payload for multimodal/structured prompts; if provided, it is used instead of prompt.

generation_config.description: Gemini generationConfig parameters (e.g., temperature, topP, maxOutputTokens).

safety_settings.description: Gemini safety settings array to apply to the request.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_functionCall
tool_schemas.description: Generates content with tool/function calling enabled and returns either a normal model response or a single function-call request chosen by the model from `tools_declarations`, using `contents` instead of `prompt` when provided. This endpoint does not page and only returns the first tool call when the model requests one. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid required fields (including malformed `api_key_id`), empty/invalid `tools_declarations`, or unsupported extra properties, UNAUTHORIZED if `api_key_id` is not accessible/allowed, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Gemini rejects the request or blocks output due to safety or invalid configuration.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for this function-call-enabled generation.

model.description: Gemini model name to use for generation.

prompt.description: Plain text prompt to generate from and potentially trigger a function call.

contents.description: Full Gemini contents payload; if provided, it is used instead of prompt.

safety_settings.description: Gemini safety settings array to apply to the request.

tools_declarations.description: List of function/tool declarations the model is allowed to call.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_startChat
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new stateful chat session bound to the provided `api_key_id` and `model`, optionally seeding it with `history`, and returns the new `session_id` plus the persisted session metadata. This endpoint does not page; session-wide `generation_config`, `safety_settings`, and optional `system_instruction` are stored and applied to subsequent turns unless overridden per request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid required fields (including malformed `api_key_id`) or unsupported extra properties, UNAUTHORIZED if `api_key_id` is not accessible/allowed, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Gemini rejects the initial chat configuration/history.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to bind to the new chat session.

model.description: Gemini model name to use for the chat session.

history.description: Optional initial conversation history to seed the session.

generation_config.description: Session-wide Gemini generationConfig applied to subsequent turns unless overridden.

system_instruction.description: Optional system instruction object for the chat session (Gemini systemInstruction).

tool_schemas.name: gemini_sendMessage
tool_schemas.description: Appends a user turn to an existing chat session and returns the model’s next response for that session, using `content` instead of `message` when `content` is provided and optionally enabling tools for that turn via `tools_declarations`. This endpoint does not page; the new message and the model response are persisted to the session transcript for consistent replay/audit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, missing required fields, or unsupported extra properties, NOT_FOUND if `session_id` does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if the provided `api_key_id` is not allowed to access the session, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Gemini rejects the turn (e.g., invalid config/tool schema or safety refusal).

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key associated with the session (used for auditing/authorization).

session_id.description: Chat session ID to send the message to.

message.description: User message text to append to the chat session.

content.description: Full Gemini message content payload; if provided, it is used instead of message.

generation_config.description: Optional per-turn generationConfig overrides for this message send.

safety_settings.description: Optional per-turn safety settings overrides for this message send.

tools_declarations.description: Optional tool/function declarations available to the model for this turn.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_sendFunctionResult
tool_schemas.description: Appends one or more tool/function execution results to an existing chat session and returns the model’s subsequent response continuing from that tool outcome. This endpoint does not page; `function_results` are persisted to the session transcript and the follow-up generation respects any provided per-turn overrides. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, missing/empty `function_results`, or unsupported extra properties, NOT_FOUND if `session_id` does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if the provided `api_key_id` is not allowed to access the session, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state that can accept function results (e.g., no pending tool call to satisfy).

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key associated with the session (used for auditing/authorization).

session_id.description: Chat session ID to send function results to.

function_results.description: One or more function execution results to deliver back to the model.

generation_config.description: Optional per-turn generationConfig overrides for the follow-up model response.

safety_settings.description: Optional per-turn safety settings overrides for the follow-up model response.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_uploadFile
tool_schemas.description: Uploads a local file to the Gemini File API using the specified Google AI Studio key and returns the remote file metadata (including its unique name/URI) mirrored into Gemini Server for later list/get/delete consistency. This endpoint does not page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid required fields (including malformed `api_key_id`) or unsupported extra properties, NOT_FOUND if `local_path` cannot be read, UNAUTHORIZED if the key is not accessible/allowed, CONFLICT if the provided key is a Vertex AI key (File API not supported), and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the Gemini File API rejects the upload (e.g., size/type/quota).

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for upload (must be a Google AI Studio key, not Vertex AI).

local_path.description: Local filesystem path of the file to upload.

display_name.description: Optional display name to assign to the uploaded file.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type hint for the upload (e.g., "application/pdf").

tool_schemas.name: gemini_listFiles
tool_schemas.description: Lists files previously uploaded to the Gemini File API for the provided AI Studio key and returns a paginated list of file metadata mirrored by Gemini Server. Results are paged using the underlying Gemini page token semantics: the response returns the current page of items and a next page token when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameters or unsupported extra properties, UNAUTHORIZED if `api_key_id` is not accessible/allowed, CONFLICT if the provided key is a Vertex AI key (File API not supported), and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the Gemini File API list operation fails or is rejected.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Gemini File API request (must be a Google AI Studio key).

page_size.description: Maximum number of files to return in a single page.

page_token.description: Continuation token from a previous listFiles response to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_getFile
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific file previously uploaded to the Gemini API. NOTE: This API is not supported on Vertex AI clients. It only works with Google AI Studio API keys. Requires the unique file name (e.g., 'files/abc123xyz').

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Gemini File API request (must be a Google AI Studio key).

tool_schemas.name: gemini_deleteFile
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified upstream Gemini File API resource (name like "files/…") using the stored Google AI Studio API key and returns a deletion confirmation after the upstream delete succeeds. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if api_key_id or name is missing/doesn’t match the required pattern, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the api_key_id is unknown, not permitted for this workspace, or refers to a non–AI Studio (e.g., Vertex) key. Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist (or is not visible to the key) and UPSTREAM_ERROR for upstream quota/permission failures or transient Gemini API errors.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Gemini File API request (must be a Google AI Studio key).

name.description: Upstream Gemini file resource name to delete (e.g., 'files/abc123xyz').

tool_schemas.name: gemini_createCache
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Cached Content resource for the given Gemini model and contents, and returns the created cache metadata (including its resource name) as returned by the upstream Cached Content API. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, ttl_seconds < 1, or contents is not in the expected Gemini contents shape; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the api_key_id is unknown or not allowed, and NOT_SUPPORTED if the specified model does not support cached content. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED for upstream quota/rate-limit enforcement and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other upstream failures (including invalid model access).

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Cached Content API request.

model.description: Gemini model name that will own the cached content (must be caching-compatible).

display_name.description: Human-friendly name to assign to the cached content resource.

contents.description: Prompt contents to cache, in Gemini 'contents' format.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live for the cached content, in seconds.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_listCaches
tool_schemas.description: Lists Cached Content resources visible to the provided API key and returns a page of cache metadata plus next_page_token when additional results are available; paging is controlled by page_size (max 1000) and page_token from a prior response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_size is out of range or page_token is malformed, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the api_key_id is unknown or not allowed. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED for upstream rate limits and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other upstream Cached Content API failures.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Cached Content API request.

page_size.description: Maximum number of cached content resources to return in a single page.

page_token.description: Continuation token from a previous listCaches response to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_getCache
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns metadata for a single cached content resource (name like "cachedContents/…") using the stored API key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if api_key_id or name is missing/invalid, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the api_key_id is unknown or not allowed to access cached content. Raises NOT_FOUND if the cache does not exist (or is not visible to the key) and UPSTREAM_ERROR for upstream permission/quota/transient errors.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Cached Content API request.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_updateCache
tool_schemas.description: Updates a cached content resource’s mutable metadata (display_name and/or ttl_seconds) and returns the updated cache metadata from the upstream API. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is invalid, ttl_seconds < 1, or no updatable fields are provided; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the api_key_id is unknown or not allowed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the cache does not exist (or is not visible to the key), CONFLICT if the resource cannot be updated due to upstream state/precondition failure, and UPSTREAM_ERROR/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for other upstream failures.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Cached Content API request.

name.description: Upstream cached content resource name to update (e.g., 'cachedContents/abc123xyz').

display_name.description: New human-friendly display name for the cached content resource.

ttl_seconds.description: New time-to-live for the cached content, in seconds.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_deleteCache
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified cached content resource (name like "cachedContents/…") and returns a deletion confirmation once the upstream delete completes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if api_key_id or name is missing/invalid, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the api_key_id is unknown or not allowed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the cache does not exist (or is not visible to the key) and UPSTREAM_ERROR/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for upstream permission, quota, or transient failures.

api_key_id.description: ID of the stored API key to use for the upstream Cached Content API request.

name.description: Upstream cached content resource name to delete (e.g., 'cachedContents/abc123xyz').

tool_schemas.name: gemini_listGenerationRequests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded generation requests in reverse chronological order for audit and debugging, with stable cursor pagination. Returns an array of generation_requests plus a next_page_token when more results are available. Refuses invalid cursors and rejects filters with invalid enums (VALIDATION_ERROR).

api_key_id.description: If provided, only returns generation requests created using this stored API key.

chat_session_id.description: If provided, only returns generation requests associated with this chat session.

status.description: If provided, only returns requests in this lifecycle status.

model.description: If provided, only returns requests made against this Gemini model name.

is_stream.description: If provided, filters to streaming (true) or non-streaming (false) requests.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor token from a previous list call; derived from (created_at, id).

created_at_lte.description: Optional upper bound on created_at for pagination or time-bounded queries (inclusive).

tool_schemas.name: gemini_getGenerationRequest
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single generation request by id and returns its full recorded metadata including status, any error_code/error_message, and response/usage fields when available. Refuses unknown ids (NOT_FOUND).

id.description: ID of the generation_requests row to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_cancelGenerationRequest
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel a queued or running generation request and transitions it to status='cancelled' when cancellation succeeds or is already complete. Returns the updated generation_requests record; refuses cancellation of terminal requests (succeeded|failed|cancelled) with a CONFLICT error.

id.description: ID of the generation_requests row to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason for audit logs.

tool_schemas.name: gemini_updateApiKey
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a stored API key, including lifecycle status transitions (active↔disabled, and revoke). Returns the updated api_keys record. Refuses invalid transitions (CONFLICT) and rejects attempts to change immutable fields such as provider/key material (VALIDATION_ERROR).

id.description: ID of the stored API key to update.

display_name.description: New human-readable label for this key.

status.description: New lifecycle status for this key; transitions are enforced (e.g., revoked cannot be reactivated).

daily_request_limit.description: Optional per-day request quota for this key (0 disables requests).

daily_token_limit.description: Optional per-day token quota for this key (0 disables token usage).

tool_schemas.name: gemini_endChat
tool_schemas.description: Ends an active chat session and transitions chat_sessions.status from 'active' to 'ended', setting ended_at. Returns the updated chat session. Refuses requests for non-active sessions (CONFLICT) and unknown ids (NOT_FOUND).

chat_session_id.description: ID of the chat session to end.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def gemini_endChat(chat_session_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0350000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0350000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{secrets.token_hex(12)}"

    chat_sessions = _load("chat_sessions.json")
    gen_reqs = _load("generation_requests.json")

    # Validate: accept both gmsn_ (actual) and gmsc_ (tool schema)
    if not isinstance(chat_session_id, str) or not (chat_session_id.startswith("gmsn_") or chat_session_id.startswith("gmsc_")):
        ts = _now_iso()
        gen_reqs.append({
            "id": _new_id("gmrq_audit"),
            "api_key_id": "gmsk_audit",
            "tool_name": "gemini_endChat",
            "model": "audit",
            "is_stream": False,
            "chat_session_id": chat_session_id if isinstance(chat_session_id, str) else None,
            "prompt_text": None,
            "contents": {"chat_session_id": chat_session_id},
            "generation_config": None,
            "safety_settings": None,
            "tools_declarations": None,
            "function_call_request": None,
            "response_text": None,
            "response_raw": {"status": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)},
            "usage": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "Invalid chat_session_id.",
            "started_at": ts,
            "completed_at": ts,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        })
        _save("generation_requests.json", gen_reqs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid chat_session_id.")

    idx = None
    for i, s in enumerate(chat_sessions):
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == chat_session_id:
            idx = i
            break
    if idx is None:
        ts = _now_iso()
        gen_reqs.append({
            "id": _new_id("gmrq_audit"),
            "api_key_id": "gmsk_audit",
            "tool_name": "gemini_endChat",
            "model": "audit",
            "is_stream": False,
            "chat_session_id": chat_session_id,
            "prompt_text": None,
            "contents": {"chat_session_id": chat_session_id},
            "generation_config": None,
            "safety_settings": None,
            "tools_declarations": None,
            "function_call_request": None,
            "response_text": None,
            "response_raw": {"status": "NOT_FOUND", "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)},
            "usage": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_code": "NOT_FOUND",
            "error_message": "Chat session not found.",
            "started_at": ts,
            "completed_at": ts,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        })
        _save("generation_requests.json", gen_reqs)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Chat session not found.")

    sess = chat_sessions[idx]
    if sess.get("status") != "active":
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Chat session is not active.")

    # Lifecycle: active -> ended
    now = _now_iso()
    sess["status"] = "ended"
    sess["ended_at"] = now
    sess["updated_at"] = now
    chat_sessions[idx] = sess
    _save("chat_sessions.json", chat_sessions)

    ts = _now_iso()
    gen_reqs.append({
        "id": _new_id("gmrq_audit"),
        "api_key_id": sess.get("api_key_id") or "gmsk_audit",
        "tool_name": "gemini_endChat",
        "model": "audit",
        "is_stream": False,
        "chat_session_id": chat_session_id,
        "prompt_text": None,
        "contents": {"chat_session_id": chat_session_id},
        "generation_config": None,
        "safety_settings": None,
        "tools_declarations": None,
        "function_call_request": None,
        "response_text": None,
        "response_raw": {"status": "ok", "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)},
        "usage": None,
        "status": "succeeded",
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": ts,
        "completed_at": ts,
        "created_at": ts,
        "updated_at": ts,
    })
    _save("generation_requests.json", gen_reqs)

    return {"chat_session": sess}

metadata.name: Gemini Server
metadata.description: This backend powers an MCP "Gemini Server" that proxies Google Gemini (AI Studio) generation, chat sessions, function-call mediation, and manages Gemini File API uploads and Cached Content resources. It stores stateful chat sessions/messages, tracks generation requests (streaming and non-streaming),
